question: Estimate the server load (peak concurrent users) during IPL final ticket booking on BookMyShow.
idealClarificationQuestions: Peak concurrent users in the first 5 minutes of ticket sale? Yes.
IPL final at Wankhede (~33K capacity) or Narendra Modi (~1L capacity)? Use Narendra Modi for biggest case (~1L seats).
BookMyShow only or all booking partners (Paytm Insider, Insider.in)? BookMyShow as primary.
Including users who fail to log in / time out in queue? Yes — total trying.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Stadium capacity → demand multiplier → user/ticket ratio → spike concentration.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: IPL final tickets available: ~70K-80K public sale (after sponsor / hospitality).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Concurrent peak (first 60 seconds): ~50% of these load simultaneously = 2-3M concurrent users.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Successful purchases: 70K tickets / ~3 tix per booking = ~23K successful transactions in first 30 min.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, attempt to book in first 5 min of sale

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~50% of these load simultaneously = 2-3M concurrent users.
70K tickets / ~3 tix per booking = ~23K successful transactions in first 30 min.

calculationFlow: Of these, attempt to book in first 5 min of sale: ~80% = 4-5.5M unique users hitting site.
Concurrent peak (first 60 seconds): ~50% of these load simultaneously = 2-3M concurrent users.
BookMyShow servers see ~2-3 million concurrent users in the peak minute.
Successful purchases: 70K tickets / ~3 tix per booking = ~23K successful transactions in first 30 min.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Successful purchases: 70K tickets / ~3 tix per booking = ~23K successful transactions in first 30 min.
